act_title: The Cigarettes and Other Tobacco Products (Prohibition of Advertisement and Regulation of Trade and Commerce, Production, Supply and Distribution) Act, 2003
title: Subs. by Act 38 of 2007, s. 2, for certain words (w.e.f. 24-9-2007).
text:
1. Subs. by Act 38 of 2007, s. 2, for certain words (w.e.f. 24-9-2007).

7

-----

Provided that the nicotine and tar contents shall not exceed the maximum permissible quantity thereof

as may be prescribed by rules made under this Act.
